Loading all required packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(ausflora)
library(performance)
library(austraits)
library(patchwork)
library(emmeans)
library(GGally)
library(multcompView)
library(networkD3)
```


Importing and combining data
```{r}
xylem_areas <- list.files("area_data/", full.names = T) |> 
  map_df(read.csv, header = T) |> 
  separate(Image, c("family_original", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species_name", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |>
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000,
         radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi))

resources <- load_taxonomic_resources()     # Used for ausflora functions

apc_names <- update_taxonomy(xylem_areas$species_name, resources = resources) |>
  filter(grepl("accepted|synonym|variant", taxonomicStatusClean)) 

# write.csv(apc_names["canonicalName"], "data/apc_names.csv", row.names = F)

gbif_names <- read.csv("data/gbif_namematched.csv", header = T) |> filter(grepl("SPECIES|VARIETY", rank)) 

namematched <- gbif_names |> select(verbatimScientificName, species, genus) |> 
  left_join(apc_names[c("aligned_name", "canonicalName", "family")], by = c("verbatimScientificName" = "canonicalName")) |> 
  rename(species_name = aligned_name, gbif_name = species, apc_name = verbatimScientificName)

xylem_areas <- xylem_areas |> left_join(namematched, by = "species_name")
```


Dataset statistics
```{r}
data_dir <- "/Users/elijahmagistrado/OneDrive - UNSW/images"

all_image_names <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "_x.jpg", recursive = T) |> 
  as.data.frame() 

names(all_image_names)[1] <- "file_name"

# Correcting for strange formatting of image folders
non_eucalypts <- all_image_names |>
  separate(file_name, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  filter(!grepl("/", species)) |> 
  distinct(family, species)

eucalypts <- all_image_names |>
  separate(file_name, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  filter(grepl("/", species)) |> 
  separate(species, c("other", "species"), sep = "/", extra = "merge") |> 
  separate(species, c("family2", "species"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |> 
  distinct(family, species)

species_merged <- bind_rows(non_eucalypts, eucalypts)

images_apc_names <- update_taxonomy(species_merged$species, resources = resources) |>
  filter(grepl("accepted|synonym|variant", taxonomicStatusClean)) |> distinct(canonicalName)

nrow(apc_names |> distinct(canonicalName))
```

Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)
zanne_native <- native_anywhere_in_australia(zanne_data$Binomial, 
                                             resources = resources) |> 
  right_join(zanne_data, by = c("species" = "Binomial")) |> 
  filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "TRUE" )


# Calculating same variables on our data
comparison_data <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000, 
         total_area = max(area_mm)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(n=n(),
         mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T),
         n_per_area = n/total_area,
         area_n_ratio = mean_area/n_per_area) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(N = mean(n_per_area, na.rm = T),         # Vessel density
            A = mean(mean_area, na.rm = T)) |>       # Mean area 
  drop_na() |> 
  left_join(namematched[c("apc_name", "family")], by = "apc_name") |>
  distinct()


ggplot() +
  geom_hex(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), bins = 15) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "light grey", high = "dark green") +
  geom_point(data = comparison_data, aes(x = N, y = A), size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Vessel density"~ (mm^-2)) +
  ylab("Mean vessel area"~ (mm^2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave("figures/zanne_plot.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")
```

Calculating Dh and VLF
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- xylem_areas |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |>
  group_by(apc_name, genus, other) |> 
  summarise(sample_Dh = sum(radius^5)/ sum(radius^4)) |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(sample_Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas["apc_name"], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(n_samples = n()) |> 
  drop_na() 

xylem_VLF <- xylem_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(sample_lumen_area = max(Area.µm.2)) |> 
  filter(Name %in% c("vessel", "part")) |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  summarise(vessel_area = sum(Area.µm.2),
            sample_lumen_frac = vessel_area/sample_lumen_area) |> 
  distinct() |>
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(mean_VLF = mean(sample_lumen_frac, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = "apc_name") |> 
  left_join(xylem_areas["apc_name"], by = "apc_name") |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(n_samples = n()) |> 
  drop_na() 
```

Phylogenetic variation in vessel size and VLF
```{r}
generate_label_df <- function(TUKEY, variable){

     Tukey.levels <- TUKEY[[variable]][,4]
     Tukey.labels <- data.frame(multcompLetters(Tukey.levels)['Letters'])

     Tukey.labels$treatment=rownames(Tukey.labels)
     Tukey.labels=Tukey.labels[order(Tukey.labels$treatment) , ]
     return(Tukey.labels)
     }
 
Dh_aov <- aov(log(mean_Dh)~family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_aov)
Dh_Tukey <- TukeyHSD(Dh_aov)

LABELS <- generate_label_df(Dh_Tukey , "family")

xylem_Dh <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(LABELS, by = c("family" = "treatment"))

Dh_family_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = xylem_Dh, aes(fct_reorder(family, mean_Dh, median), mean_Dh)) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(data = xylem_Dh |> group_by(family, Letters) |> summarise(max_Dh = max(mean_Dh)), 
            aes(family, y = max_Dh + 20, label = Letters)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Family") +
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  coord_flip()

VLF_aov <- aov(log(mean_VLF)~family, data = xylem_VLF)
summary(VLF_aov)
VLF_Tukey <- TukeyHSD(VLF_aov)

# Phylogenetic differences
VLF_LABELS <- generate_label_df(VLF_Tukey, "family")

xylem_VLF <- xylem_VLF |> left_join(VLF_LABELS, by = c("family" = "treatment"))

VLF_family_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = xylem_VLF, aes(fct_reorder(family, mean_VLF, median), mean_VLF)) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(data = xylem_VLF |> group_by(family, Letters) |> summarise(max_VLF = max(mean_VLF)),
            aes(family, y = max_VLF + 0.5, label = Letters)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  xlab("Family") +
  ylab("VLF") +
  coord_flip()

Dh_family_plot / VLF_family_plot

ggsave("figures/Dh_VLF_family.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")
```


Phylogenetic differences in vessel size response to rainfall
```{r}
Dh_MAP_family_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP)+family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_MAP_family_lm)
anova(Dh_MAP_family_lm)

Dh_family_interaction <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP)*family, data = xylem_Dh)
summary(Dh_family_interaction)

plot_interaction <- function(model, data) {
  model_p <- predict.lm(model, data, se.fit = T)
  
  pred_data <- bind_cols(data, model_p)
  
  return(pred_data)
}

lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP), data = xylem_Dh |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae")) |> summary()

Dh_pred <- plot_interaction(Dh_family_interaction, xylem_Dh[, c(2, 4, 16)])

Dh_myrtaceae_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_MAP)*genus, data = xylem_Dh |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae", n_samples > 5))
summary(Dh_myrtaceae_lm)

Dh_genus_pred <- plot_interaction(Dh_myrtaceae_lm, xylem_Dh |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae", n_samples > 5) |> select(mean_Dh, mean_MAP, genus, family))

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = Dh_pred |> filter(family %in% c("Fabaceae", "Myrtaceae", "Proteaceae")), aes(mean_MAP, exp(fit)), col = "dark grey", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = Dh_genus_pred |> filter(genus != "Corymbia"), aes(mean_MAP, exp(fit), col = genus), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = xylem_Dh, aes(mean_MAP, mean_Dh), size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = xylem_Dh |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae", n_samples > 5), aes(mean_MAP, mean_Dh, col = genus), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") +
  ylab(D[h]~"(µm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.5, 0.15), legend.background = element_rect(fill = NULL)) +
  labs(colour = "Genus")

ggsave("figures/Dh_MAP_family.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm")

```


Phylogenetic differences in VLF response to rainfall
```{r}
VLF_family_lm <- lm(log(mean_VLF)~log(mean_MAP)+family, data = xylem_VLF)

lm(log(mean_VLF)~log(mean_MAP), data = xylem_VLF |> filter(genus == "Melaleuca")) |> summary()

  geom_line(data = VLF_pred |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae"), aes(mean_MAP, exp(fit)), col = "dark grey", linewidth = 1) +

  geom_point(data = xylem_VLF, aes(mean_MAP, mean_VLF), size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = xylem_VLF |> filter(family == "Myrtaceae", n_samples > 5), aes(mean_MAP, mean_VLF, col = genus), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Mean annual precipitation (mm)") +
  ylab("VLF") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.5, 0.15), legend.background = element_rect(fill = NULL)) +
  labs(colour = "Genus")
```

```{r}
  ylab("Family") +

ggsave("figures/VLF_pairwise.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 7.34, units = "cm")


```

adding height data
```{r}
austraits <- readRDS("data/austraits-4.2.0.rds")

height_data <- extract_trait(austraits, "plant_height")

euc_heights <- height_data$traits |> 
  filter(taxon_name %in% xylem_Dh$apc_name) |> 
  filter(value_type == "maximum") |> 
  group_by(taxon_name) |> 
  summarise(max_height = max(value),
            mean_height = mean(value))

xylem_Dh_height <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(euc_heights, by = c("apc_name"= "taxon_name"))

xylem_Dh_height

ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(mean_height, mean_Dh)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, col = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(col = climate), size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Spectral") +
  # scale_colour_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "dark grey", high = "blue", midpoint = median(log(xylem_Dh_height$mean_MAP)), trans = "log") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Maximum plant height (m)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  labs(colour = "MAP (mm)")
  
ggsave("figures/Dh_height_MAP.png", scale = 1, width = 11, height = 7.34, units = "cm")

Dh_height_lm <- lm(log(mean_Dh)~log(mean_height), data = xylem_Dh_height)
summary(Dh_height_lm)
```


Sankey diagram for distribution of species in dataset
```{r}
links <- read.csv("data/sankey_links.csv", header = T)

nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique()
)

links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
              sinksRight=FALSE, width = 600, height = 600, fontSize = 20, fontFamily = "Arial")

p

library(cowplot)

plot_grid(p, whittaker)
```
